token.label: GitHub token
token.description: Optional. Reading runs and jobs works anonymously on a public repository; job logs and the cancel/re-run verbs need a token. GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN in the server's environment, or a logged-in `gh`, is tried before this.

apiBase.label: API base URL
apiBase.description: Only for GitHub Enterprise, e.g. https://github.example.com/api/v3. Empty means api.github.com.

perPage.label: Runs per read
perPage.description: How many runs one read asks for (1-100). A page that comes back full is reported as truncated rather than pretending the list is complete.

pollSeconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often a watched repository is re-read. An unchanged read answers 304 and costs no API quota.

logTailKb.label: Log tail (KB)
logTailKb.description: How much of a job log the panel keeps. The full log is still available on request.
